Exists fun ordinary =>
  Exists fun native =>
    And
      (∀ (raw : Paper2.ExactInput.RawLanguage) (hraw : raw.Valid),
        Exists fun b =>
          Exists fun steps =>
            And
              (Eq (Nat.iterate (fun c => c.bind ordinary.machine.tm.step) steps (Option.some (ordinary.initial raw)))
                (Option.some (ordinary.final b)))
              (And (Eq (ordinary.machine.tm.step (ordinary.final b)) Option.none)
                (Iff (Eq b Bool.true) (Paper2.Tractable.Tract (Paper2.ExactInput.Language.family ⟨raw, hraw⟩)))))
      (And
        (∀ (raw : Paper2.ExactInput.RawLanguage) (hraw : raw.Valid),
          Exists fun b =>
            Exists fun steps =>
              And
                (Eq (Nat.iterate (fun c => c.bind native.machine.tm.step) steps (Option.some (native.initial raw)))
                  (Option.some (native.final b)))
                (And (Eq (native.machine.tm.step (native.final b)) Option.none)
                  (Iff (Eq b Bool.true) (Paper2.Tractable.Tract (Paper2.kImage ⟨raw, hraw⟩)))))
        (∀ (L : Paper2.ExactInput.Language),
          And (Iff (Eq (ordinary.decision L) Bool.true) (Paper2.Tractable.Tract L.family))
            (And (Iff (Eq (native.decision L) Bool.true) (Paper2.Tractable.Tract (Paper2.kImage L)))
              (And (Paper2.Tractable.Tract L.family → Paper2.Problem.InFP Paper2.Problem.Wiring.ordinary L)
                (And
                  (Not (Paper2.Tractable.Tract L.family) → Paper2.Problem.SharpPHard Paper2.Problem.Wiring.ordinary L)
                  (And (Paper2.Tractable.Tract (Paper2.kImage L) → Paper2.Problem.InFP Paper2.Problem.Wiring.nativeX L)
                    (Not (Paper2.Tractable.Tract (Paper2.kImage L)) →
                      Paper2.Problem.SharpPHard Paper2.Problem.Wiring.nativeX L)))))))
